translation: Thirty-three: Someone asks what the accumulation is ultimately like. I say: Examining the formula books, yin and yang are not harmonious, the viscera and bowels are vacuous and weak, and the four qi and seven emotions are abnormal, so accumulation and gathering arise, becoming concretions and conglomerations over time, phlegm-rheum in the middle, food accumulation on the right, and dead blood on the left. From what I have felt in recent years, these are all other diseases; accumulation is not like this. Why? Because it is hard as stone and flows like sand, and examining its substance, it all seems to be small water blisters.
